attack_techniques: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Bypass User Account Control (T1548.002)
attackers_goals: Gain higher privileges by bypassing the User Account Control (UAC).
description: Attackers may use Fodhelper.exe to bypass UAC (User Account Control) by having it spawn their malicious process.
investigative_actions: Search for a registry event that changes the key Software\Classes\ms-settings. Review the process that made the registry key. Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Fodhelper.exe UAC bypass
